in_english.name: Mahban
in_english.meaning: Compassionate and charitable people, those who give to others
in_english.long_meaning: Compassionate and charitable people, those who give to others, those who mention the name of Allah, those who possess knowledge, those who possess authority, and those who take care of the poor and give charity.
